text.tspan: helm upgrade (Helm 3, client-side): one patch built from three inputs
what is in the cluster now
• field in NEW differs from LIVE → set it to NEW
• field in OLD but removed from NEW → delete it
• field only in LIVE → leave it alone
reverted: the chart sets this field,
even if the chart did not change
kept: the chart never set it
live edits survive if values unchanged
Helm only compares when you run it: it never watches the cluster. Helm 4 new releases use server-side apply
instead, so a field changed by kubectl edit gives a conflict error unless you pass --force-conflicts.
